subject: Dedicated capacity demo / throughput confirmation - Elliptix
messages:
From: support@redwood-inference.com
To: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@elliptix.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Thanks for your interest — Dedicated demo request received

Hi Tom,

Thanks for signing up to request a Dedicated capacity demo. We got your request and an SDR will reach out shortly to align on throughput and demo scope. To help the team prepare, could you confirm: 

- Target sustained tokens/sec or requests per minute (rough peak and steady-state)
- Typical sequence lengths and concurrency (e.g., 128 tokens, 100 concurrent users)
- Any latency SLOs (p95/p99 targets)

If you have a sample trace or CSV of request volumes, reply to this thread and attach it — that helps us pick the right instance/quantization profile.

Regards,
Redwood Support
attachments: none

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@elliptix.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T09:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated demo request — quick questions + scheduling

Tom —

Quick intro: I’m Aditya on the SDR team; I’ll coordinate the demo and bring Monica (Solutions Engineer) who will run the throughput/latency portion. Thanks for the signup. Two quick asks so Monica can scope the environment: 

1) Can you confirm a realistic peak concurrency and a desired p95 latency target? Example: 200 concurrent sessions with p95 < 200ms.
2) Are you planning to run streaming responses (token-by-token) or chunked full-response calls?

Proposed times for a 45-minute demo (Monica will show a short perf run):
- Tue, Jan 19 — 10:00–10:45 PT
- Tue, Jan 19 — 14:00–14:45 PT
- Wed, Jan 20 — 11:00–11:45 PT

Reply with the best slot and attach any sample traffic if you have it.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
attachments: none

From: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@elliptix.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Nguyen <sara@elliptix.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated demo request — quick questions + scheduling

Aditya, Monica —

Thanks for the quick reply. A few details to help scope: 

- Peak concurrency: 350 RPS (we think in requests per second); steady-state ~80 RPS.
- Typical sequence: 256 tokens average, occasional spikes to 1024 for long-form generation.
- Latency: aiming for p95 < 300ms; p99 < 700ms ideally.
- We use streaming on customer-facing flows and full-response in async batch jobs.

I attached a sample CSV of a 24-hour traffic slice. We prefer the Tue 14:00 PT slot.

Cheers,
Tom
Head of Platform, Elliptix
attachments: elliptix-sample-traffic.csv

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@elliptix.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-18T11:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated demo request — scope confirmed / invite sent

Tom —

Perfect, that’s very helpful. I reviewed the CSV and the mix of streaming + full-response means we should demonstrate: 

- Live stream path with prefix/KV cache enabled (to show p95 improvements)
- A short batch job to show throughput on reserved capacity and how autoscale/burst behaves
- Kernel/quantization tradeoffs and a quick forecast of cost per 1k tokens at your expected load

I’ve created a calendar invite for Tue, Jan 19 14:00–14:45 PT and added a short pre-demo checklist for you to review. Invite link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=elliptix-demo-20270119 

Pre-demo checklist (please confirm before the meeting):
- Admin access for one engineer to a temporary test endpoint (we’ll provide keys)
- A sample prompt set for the live demo (3 examples)
- Confirmation whether any data residency constraints (region/us or eu) apply

If something comes up and you need to move, flag here and we’ll reschedule.

—Monica
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: SLA-dedicated-template.pdf

From: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@elliptix.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-19T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated demo request — scope confirmed / invite sent

Monica, Aditya —

Heads up: server maintenance on our side will run Tue 13:30–15:30 PT so the 14:00 slot conflicts. Can we shift to Wed, Jan 20 at 11:00 PT? Same agenda. Apologies for the late notice.

Tom
attachments: none

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@elliptix.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-19T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated demo request — reschedule to Wed 11:00 PT

Tom —

No problem; thanks for the heads up. Wed, Jan 20 11:00–11:45 PT works for Monica and me. I updated the invite and included a short agenda below. Please confirm the engineer who will join so we can provision a test key.

Agenda (45m):
- 5m intro / goals
- 15m live streaming demo (p95/p99 metrics and cache impact)
- 15m throughput test on Dedicated pool (sustained load simulation at your 350 RPS peak)
- 5m cost forecast + next steps (Dedicated sizing / PoC commit)

If you can drop the engineer’s email and the sample prompts to this thread before Wed 9:00 PT, we’ll pre-provision access.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
SDR, Redwood Inference
